summaries.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）用量报表插件：按日/月汇聚 token 与估算费用（USD）、月度报表、预算告警、Claude Code/Codex 式每日贡献格子与趣味统计。Usage report plugin for DeepSeek Harness: daily/monthly token & estimated cost (USD) aggregation, monthly reports, budget alerts, daily contribution grid & fun stats.
